title: IP and MAC history
intro: Where each machine was seen: its MAC, the IPs it had, the switch port it was plugged into and the seat on that port. Searched by IP or MAC; a port's or a seat's history from the floor plan.
placeholder: IP or MAC, or the start of one
start: Type an IP or a MAC
startDesc: Any notation works for a MAC (aa:bb:cc, aabb.cc, AA-BB-CC). An IP is searched by its start, so 10.4.12 finds the whole range.
